integrity: The universal bound and attaining construction are proved combinatorially. Exhaustive computation is independent corroboration only. Same-model review passed; no independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly one absorption; multiple absorptions are not analyzed.
The theorem is an inverse-ball maximum and does not provide the forward-ball distribution or an optimal correcting-code size.
A 2024 follow-up was accessible only through bibliographic and abstract material, leaving a residual risk of an unadvertised overlapping statement.
title: Exact maximum inverse degree of the one-absorption channel
